title: The Man Who Was Dead for 18 Years
aria: Animated short about Lal Bihari, the Uttar Pradesh farmer who was declared dead on paper from 1976 to 1994
foot: Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects: original score with CC0 samples (VSCO 2 Community Edition, Kenney). Events follow published accounts of Lal Bihari 'Mritak'; faces, places and staging are illustration.
